message:
Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/openthread && cat > /workspace/candidate_trace.json <<'JSON'
[
  {"step":1,"file":"tests/fuzz/radio_receive_done.cpp","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":44,"var":"data[0..size-1]","code":"memcpy(buf, data, frame.mLength);","note":"The fuzzer input bytes are copied into a radio frame payload, so attacker-controlled bytes become the packet delivered into the stack."},
  {"step":2,"file":"tests/fuzz/radio_receive_done.cpp","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":46,"var":"frame","code":"otPlatRadioReceiveDone(sInstance, &frame, OT_ERROR_NONE);","note":"The crafted frame is injected into OpenThread as if it were received from the radio."},
  {"step":3,"file":"src/core/thread/network_data_leader_ftd.cpp","function":"HandleCommissioningSet","line":198,"var":"aMessage","code":"void Leader::HandleCommissioningSet(Coap::Header &aHeader, Message &aMessage, const Ip6::MessageInfo &aMessageInfo)","note":"The injected packet is parsed by the leader's commissioning-set handler when it matches the commissioning URI path."},
  {"step":4,"file":"src/core/thread/network_data_leader_ftd.cpp","function":"HandleCommissioningSet","line":206,"var":"tlvs","code":"aMessage.Read(offset, length, tlvs);","note":"The incoming CoAP payload is copied into a local TLV buffer for manual iteration."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src/core/thread/network_data_leader_ftd.cpp","function":"HandleCommissioningSet","line":212,"var":"cur","code":"for (MeshCoP::Tlv *cur = reinterpret_cast<MeshCoP::Tlv *>(tlvs); ... cur = cur->GetNext())","note":"The code walks attacker-controlled TLVs without first validating that each TLV is well-formed before dereferencing type-specific fields."},
  {"step":6,"file":"src/core/thread/network_data_leader_ftd.cpp","function":"HandleCommissioningSet","line":228,"var":"sessionId","code":"sessionId = static_cast<MeshCoP::CommissionerSessionIdTlv *>(cur)->GetCommissionerSessionId();","note":"When the TLV type claims to be Commissioner Session ID, the code casts the raw TLV pointer and reads the session-id field even if the TLV length is malformed."},
  {"step":7,"file":"src/core/thread/network_data_leader_ftd.cpp","function":"HandleCommissioningSet","line":257,"var":"cur","code":"if (cur->GetType() == MeshCoP::Tlv::kCommissionerSessionId) { VerifyOrExit(sessionId == static_cast<MeshCoP::CommissionerSessionIdTlv *>(cur)->GetCommissionerSessionId(), ...); }","note":"The same unchecked cast is repeated while scanning the stored commissioning data, so a malformed session-id TLV can trigger an invalid read in the sink path."}
]
